# Claude Event Screensaver

> A hosted web screensaver for Claude Code community events. One URL per
> event — a pixelated "CLAUDE" title with rotating thinking-verbs, an event
> agenda with an urgency ramp toward the end, venue/wifi details, and
> scuttling Clawd crab mascots. Configs are stored server-side (Cloudflare
> KV), keyed by a 6-character ID, and protected by a per-config admin
> password.

**Base URL:** `https://claude-event-screensaver.claudecommunityau.workers.dev`

## How to set up a new screensaver (for agents)

The happy path is a single `POST /api/configs` call. You'll get back an `id`
and a public view URL (`https://.../{id}`) that anyone can open to run the
screensaver. Keep the password you chose — you need it to `PUT` updates or
`GET` the structured config back later.

1. Build a Config JSON object (shape below).
2. `POST /api/configs` with `{ config, password }`.
3. Share the returned `url` with the event runner.

### Config JSON shape

```jsonc
{
  "subtitle": "CODE CURIOUS",          // text under CLAUDE
  "event_date": "2026-05-14",          // YYYY-MM-DD, or ""
  "venue": "Granola HQ",
  "wifi": "Granola-Guest / hello123",
  "agenda": [                          // ordered, HH:MM times, 24h
    { "time": "18:00", "label": "Doors" },
    { "time": "18:30", "label": "Lightning talks" },
    { "time": "21:30", "label": "Time to go home!" }
  ],
  "verbs": [                           // rotating "thinking..." lines
    "Compiling thoughts...",
    "Reticulating splines..."
  ],
  "go_home_messages": [                // shown during final urgency phase
    "Time to go home!"
  ],
  "urgency_start_minutes_before_end": 40,  // 0-240
  "max_crabs": 5                           // 0-50 scuttling Clawds
}
```

All fields are required (except `max_crabs`, which defaults to 5). Unknown
fields are rejected. `event_date` may be an empty string if the event isn't
dated.

### Authenticated endpoints

Writes and structured reads require the password — send it as either
`X-Config-Password: <password>` or `Authorization: Bearer <password>`.

| verb   | path                  | purpose                         | password |
| ------ | --------------------- | ------------------------------- | -------- |
| POST   | `/api/configs`        | create (returns `id` + `url`)   | no       |
| GET    | `/api/configs/{id}`   | read full config                | yes      |
| PUT    | `/api/configs/{id}`   | replace config, optionally rotate password | yes |

`GET /{id}` (no `/api/` prefix) renders the screensaver in a browser — no
password needed.

### Typical agent flow

```bash
curl -X POST "$BASE/api/configs" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"config":{...},"password":"correcthorse"}'
# => {"id":"A7K3QZ","url":"$BASE/A7K3QZ"}

curl "$BASE/api/configs/A7K3QZ" -H "X-Config-Password: correcthorse"
# => full stored config

curl -X PUT "$BASE/api/configs/A7K3QZ" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Config-Password: correcthorse" \
  -d '{"config":{...updated...}}'
# => {"id":"A7K3QZ","url":"$BASE/A7K3QZ"}
```

### Error codes

- `400` — bad JSON or validation failed (response `details` has zod issues)
- `401` — password missing or wrong (on `GET` the server may also return 404
  for wrong password to limit probing)
- `404` — no config with that ID

### Good defaults if the human only gave you loose details

- `subtitle`: `"CODE CURIOUS"` (the Claude Code community's event tagline)
- `verbs`: rotating "thinking-style" phrases that nod to the codebase, e.g.
  `"Compiling thoughts..."`, `"Reticulating splines..."`,
  `"Grepping for meaning..."`, `"Rebasing reality..."`. Aim for ~10–20.
- `go_home_messages`: short, warm wind-down lines, e.g.
  `"Time to go home!"`, `"The pub is calling..."`,
  `"git commit -m 'gone home'"`.
- `urgency_start_minutes_before_end`: `40` (ramp begins 40 min before the
  last agenda entry).
- `max_crabs`: `5` (good on any screen; raise for maximal crustacean energy).
- Make sure the **last** agenda row's `time` is the event end — the urgency
  ramp anchors to it.
